feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 10 September 2026 9:57pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 10 September 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland drives remnants of frontal zones across the area tonight, with high pressure near the Azores building a ridge across the Irish Sea tomorrow.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5 veering Westerly this evening, decreasing 3 or 4 by midday tomorrow, then backing South or Southwest through the afternoon, and increasing 4 or 5 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Isolated rain or showers at first, becoming fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 4 or 5, increasing 6 or 7 overnight into Saturday, then becoming Southwest 4 to 6 around midday, and decreasing Westerly 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming moderate occasionally rough overnight into Saturday, falling slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain or drizzle spread from the west overnight into Saturday, becoming fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
